description: Route Model policy and target-specific calibration used to rank all-SIMD, all-SIMT, and mixed SIMD/SIMT candidates. Model-neutral hardware measurements are referenced from microbenchmark_profile instead of duplicated here.

policy.description: Admission policy for turning a ranking into an actionable route decision. Only minimum_confidence_for_decision is currently consumed by the C++ loader.
policy.notes: Analytical payloads use SYS_CNT cycles, but Event-calibrated structural residuals make final values selection scores rather than literal measured cycles. Low-confidence rankings may act only inside the bounded calibration domain and must still pass target, unsupported-term, legality, and gain gates.

selection_calibration.description: Route-specific calibration that converts analytical resource costs into relative selection scores and bounds where those scores may make decisions.
selection_calibration.source: Bounded development activation fitted to repeated Ascend950PR Event runs for masked-rowwise and tiny-gather-dot structural domains; no workload-name matching; wider validation is still required before general rollout

coverage.description: Feature-domain limits within which Event-calibrated structural ranking is admitted; these are model validity bounds rather than hardware limits.

simd_structural_penalty_ratio.description: Additive ratios used to raise the all-SIMD structural floor for irregular addressing, mask materialization, reductions, loops, control flow, tiny dot, and rank-1 indirect reduction patterns.

mixed_simd_fraction.description: Feature-based estimate of the fraction of a normal mixed candidate payload that behaves like all-SIMD; the tiny-dot branch overrides this blend with a dedicated Event-relative residual formula.

simd.description: Inputs used to estimate the all-SIMD candidate: SIMD width, setup, operation, memory, and dot costs.

startup_system_cycles.description: Legacy SIMD pipeline startup priors in SYS_CNT cycles. Only vector is currently consumed by Route Model scoring.
startup_system_cycles.source: Legacy selection-model seed inherited from device-cycle startup values
startup_system_cycles.note: Not isolated davidV100 microbenchmark evidence; kept outside the shared catalog

memory.description: Model-specific all-SIMD memory fallback rates. vector_mte2 and mte3 plus confidence are consumed; hbm is retained only as documentary legacy context.
memory.source: Selection-model seed retained for v4 score continuity; 202.25 B/SYS_CNT-cycle corresponds to 200 GB/s and must not be presented as the davidV100 75/71 GB/s data-mover specification
memory.note: Model-specific fallback, not shared microbenchmark evidence

dot.description: All-SIMD dot setup and throughput seed used for every dot operation; current calibrated admission is narrower and covers only tiny irregular dot.

camodel_effective.note: These are effective issue rates for one FBGEMM workload, including its dependencies and stalls. They are fallback calibration seeds, not isolated instruction peak throughput or latency.
